source: single-file commits from peaceai/model/ext-corpus.json repos (newest 6000 per repo; shallow clones deepened to about 6000), set C repos excluded, LICENSE blob at each commit equal to the pinned one whose sha256 matches licenseSha256; microsoft/TypeScript skipped (pinned license sha did not reproduce; fail closed). Every recorded example is replayed through the engine by m45-config-kinds.test.ts. M56 (Architect a2): plus full histories of the example-only repos in peaceai/rules/proposals/m45-example-repos.json (licenses checked the same way; turborepo and nuxt not mined). M56 real-file check: every IMPORT_EDIT example was also replayed on the real before/after file at its commit; storybook b2773f72 was dropped (the import moved as well as changed, so more than one import changed). M57: every example is replayed on its real before/after file, committed as a fixture under peaceai/test/fixtures/m45 and pinned by git blob id (with each repo's LICENSE); all 5 PACKAGE_SCRIPT examples failed there and were dropped. M58 (Architect): examples must not overlap the training corpus, so the 4 IMPORT_EDIT examples from corpus repos (denoland/std x2, reduxjs/redux-toolkit, vitejs/vite) were dropped along with their fixtures; only example-only-list repos count. IMPORT_EDIT 2, PACKAGE_SCRIPT 0; both stay off below the bar. M58: LICENSE texts are no longer committed (they carry contact emails); each example's license is pinned by sha256 only (licenseSha256), as on the v2 branches.
